name: scrob-omnibus
description: Self-hosted media tracking for Jellyfin, Plex, and Emby — your private Letterboxd + Trakt. Omnibus image with embedded PostgreSQL (single container). Optional OpenID Connect SSO (Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak, etc.).

paths.name: PostgreSQL Data
paths.description: Embedded PostgreSQL database (required for omnibus mode)

variables.name: SECRET_KEY
variables.description: Required. JWT signing key. Generate with: openssl rand -hex 32

variables.name: Timezone
variables.description: Container timezone (e.g. Australia/Sydney, Europe/Oslo), Use TZ Identifier from: https://en.wikipedia.org/wiki/List_of_tz_database_time_zones

variables.name: PUID
variables.description: User ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 99 (nobody).

variables.name: PGID
variables.description: Group ID for file ownership. Unraid default is 100 (users).

variables.name: Enable Registrations
variables.description: Allow new users to register. Set false after initial setup.

variables.name: Server URL
variables.description: Public HTTPS URL of this Scrob instance (e.g. https://scrob.example.com). Used for email links and OIDC post-logout defaults when behind a reverse proxy.

variables.name: Enable OIDC / SSO
variables.description: Enable OpenID Connect login button. Leave false unless you have an IdP configured.

variables.name: OIDC Discovery URL
variables.description: Recommended. IdP OpenID discovery URL — enables id_token verification and stable (issuer, sub) binding. Example: https://auth.example.com/.well-known/openid-configuration

variables.name: OIDC Provider Name
variables.description: Label on the login button (e.g. Authelia, Authentik, Keycloak).

variables.name: OIDC Client ID
variables.description: OAuth/OIDC client id registered at your IdP.

variables.name: OIDC Client Secret
variables.description: OAuth/OIDC client secret (plaintext). Masked in the UI.

variables.name: OIDC Redirect URL
variables.description: Must match an IdP redirect URI. Example: https://scrob.example.com/oidc-callback

variables.name: OIDC Scopes
variables.description: Space-separated scopes requested from the IdP.

variables.name: OIDC Auto-create Users
variables.description: Create a Scrob account on first successful SSO login when no matching user exists.

variables.name: OIDC Disable Password Login
variables.description: Hide password login and registration; SSO only. Keep false until SSO is verified.
